sentences.en: This financial audit also includes an evaluation of the company's assets.
sentences.zh: 这次财务审计还包括对公司资产的评估。

sentences.en: I want a full evaluation as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我希望能尽快得到一份全面的评价。

sentences.en: I remonstrate with my boss about my performance evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我对我的绩效评估提出异议。
